headline: Trilegal advises SBI Funds International on launch of Signature CIO Funds from GIFT City
sum: Trilegal acted as fund counsel to SBI Funds International (IFSC) Limited in connection with the launch of Signature CIO Funds from GIFT City, being open-ended retail schemes, designed to provide investors in India with access to overseas…
detail: Trilegal acted as fund counsel to SBI Funds International (IFSC) Limited in connection with the launch of Signature CIO Funds from GIFT City, being open-ended retail schemes, designed to provide investors in India with access to overseas investment opportunities through investments in funds managed by Amundi Asset Management. Trilegal was engaged with the SBI Funds International (IFSC) from inception of the product such as advising on the structuring of the funds, including a comprehensive assessment of the applicable legal, regulatory and commercial considerations, and the preparation and drafting of the offering document (prospectus) and application forms.
